# Ask your Mac anything.

A clean, modern AI copilot and dictation app for your Mac.

Completely free. No account, no trial, no pro tier.

Requires macOS 12 or later on Apple Silicon. Windows is coming soon.

⌥ Space Spotlight style: press it from any app and this opens on top of whatever you are doing.

No commands match.

## Ask anything.

It opens over the window you are in, answers, and gets out of the way.

Any model. OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama - or your ChatGPT and Claude subscriptions, no API key.

Your selection comes too. Highlight text anywhere and just ask.

History stays here. In a local database on your disk.

## Dictate anywhere.

Hold a key, talk, let go. The words land where your cursor is.

Runs on your Mac. On-device in 25 languages, offline. Cloud services if you prefer.

Screen aware. It can send a screenshot too, so it works from what is on screen.

Cleaned up as you meant it. Filler words gone, or shaped into an email.

Offsite on the 14th

We are running the team offsite on the 14th in Rotterdam, and it would be good to have you there. Can you make it?

Reply accepting their invitation

## Fix it in place.

Select the sentence, press the shortcut. The correction replaces it.

Replaced in place. Straight back into the app you were typing in. Undo still works.

Review it first. The diff shows every change before anything is replaced.

Anywhere you can select text. Mail, Notes, Slack, a browser box.

### Fix Spelling & Grammar

## Prompts, your way.

Ten to start with. Change any of them, or write your own.

Add and edit. Change the wording, pick an icon and a colour.

Give it a hotkey. It runs on your selection without opening the launcher.

Rewrite, or just answer. Replace the selection, or open the answer in the panel.

## Free without limits.

Not a trial, not a free tier. The whole app, for nothing.

Your keys are yours. In the macOS Keychain, never a config file.

Nothing is collected. No account, no analytics, no server.

## Get RayMate.

One download, nothing to enter. Updates arrive when you want them.

Or with Homebrew
